title: A Ride Across Palestine
author: Anthony Trollope
description: "A Ride Across Palestine" by Anthony Trollope is a short story written in the mid-19th century during the Victorian era.
longDescription: The book details the author's journey through the Holy Land, offering insights into the geography, culture, and experiences encountered along the way.

authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
